D1_slot_structure.locked: One variant per archetype. Fixed 4-slot axis: sophisticate / defender / drifter / blended. Each slot optional (omit where divergence is nil rather than pad near-duplicates). No N-per-archetype.

D2_variant_definition.locked: A variant is the same refutation re-aimed per archetype (which true point leads, what register, what to concede). NOT rephrasing. NOT new arguments. A strength shift signals drift to argument-level = a D2 violation to catch.

D3_schema_location.locked: Nested object responses.archetypeVariants{sophisticate, defender, drifter, blended}. Corpus JSON is primary authority (authored content); index.html / JSX are derived views. Variants flow DOWN the canonical chain (no surface-only denormalization — unlike RSI).

D4_authoring_workflow.locked: Hybrid. Template scaffolds the four slots + per-archetype failure-mode / register rubric; prose handwritten per node where real divergence exists. Build order Tier-A first: slippery-slope-eugenics (A93) -> why-not-suicide (A89) -> ai-fear (B83.9), then Tier-B.

D5_display_surface.locked: In-place archetype toggle (pills: sophisticate | defender | drifter | blended) on the response view, defaulting to the canonical short/medium/long body. NOT a separate VARIANTS tab. NOT hover/expand.
D5_display_surface.deferred_subdecision: If objectionSubforms (B) is surfaced, it gets its OWN disclosure-panel decision, separate from this toggle. Deferred.

D6_grading.revisit_trigger: Revisit per-variant grading ONLY if post-build evidence shows register choice materially moves persuasive strength.
D6_grading.precondition_status: SATISFIED — corpus is 78/78 graded; not a blocker.
